question: How many of the 1,844 Kauthuma arcika verses have defensible audio?
assessed_set_definition: Every canonical_key carrying a WIKISOURCE_SA_RUNNING_SAMHITA_NUMBER citation, i.e. all 1,844 released arcika verses. Each was tested against every one of the 475 checksummed Commons recordings and against the four candidate sources named by reconnaissance.

why_zero.reason: All 475 are gana performances. Exactly 6 are transcluded from an arcika page, and all 6 sit on a CONTAINER page (an ardha or a dasati), never on a verse. Their durations are 81-399s over containers holding many verses and no source states a boundary inside any of them. Campaign rule 4 forbids attaching a long recording to an exact mantra without verified boundaries, so they are staged at container scope and at container scope only.
archive.org item metadata carries NO licenseurl and NO rights field - re-verified in this pass. Recension unstated; Kerala Samavedic tradition is substantially Jaiminiya. Also gana, not arcika.
PERMISSION_REQUIRED and already removed from this product by prior decision.
